phase1_per_band_logloss.finding: the pchip +0.0129 pooled regression concentrates IN-BAND (raw>0.70, n=162): +0.069 vs platt there vs +0.003 out-of-band. In-band concentration + the fold-stability table below = per-fold top-tail variance (Jensen), NOT a smooth discrimination loss — the e3aeece overfit hypothesis is confirmed with mechanism.

phase1_fold_stability.finding: pchip's per-fold spread at a CONSTANT raw input is 2-5x Platt's and its fits produce outputs ABOVE 1.0 (mean 1.15, max 1.55 at input 0.85 — un-clipped extrapolation). Logloss is convex: this fold-to-fold prediction variance is the direct mechanism of the pchip pooled-logloss regression. Platt's per-fold fits stay in [0,1] with std <= 0.026.

phase1_raw_ece_direct.finding: raw identity's ECE measured directly (the gate never scored the raw axis): pooled 0.0425 (== the moneyline record's metrics_raw pooled ECE — axis-exact), sealed 0.0593. At the sealed 70-80 band raw (0.0366, n=42) is far better than the published Platt axis (0.1337, n=39) — the e3aeece Branch-B over-stretch is an OUT-OF-SAMPLE cost.

phase1_hinge_scan.finding: the scan is FLAT on pooled nested logloss (range 0.6192-0.6225): the hinge cannot improve pooled sharpness over platt because platt is already near-optimal in-sample (see the pooled actual-rate table below). h=0.69 minimizes pooled band ECE (0.0073) but the pooled-ll surface does not reward any hinge.

pooled_actual_rate_by_raw_zone.finding: raw is dead-on ONLY in the 0.66-0.70 sliver (the Branch-B zone, delta 0.006); below 0.66 it is ~2pp UNDER (0.463 vs 0.483) and above 0.70 it is 9.3pp UNDER (0.759 vs 0.852). The global logistic stretch (a=1.276) is therefore genuinely justified IN-SAMPLE — the kink narrative holds only for the narrow 0.66-0.70 sliver, not as an identity-below-h serving rule.

pooled_ll_no_regression_beyond_0_001.note: BINDING — raw is +0.0030 pooled nested vs platt; platt is genuinely better in-sample (pooled above-0.70 rows realize 0.852 vs raw 0.759). Not loosened.

sealed_70_80_band_lt_0_03.note: knife-edge vs the 0.03 bar (delta 0.0066 << band binomial SE ~0.067) but above it; raw's sealed 60-70 (0.018) and S2 (ece 0.0808 vs 0.1296) gains are real

sealed_adjacent_no_regression_gt_0_01.note: raw's sealed 80+ band (0.105, n=16) regresses vs platt (0.0094, n=46); small-n but the raw top tail is genuinely under-sharpened out-of-sample

sealed_s2_arbiter.note: S2 (arbiter half): ll 0.6387 -> 0.6329, ece 0.1296 -> 0.0808 — a real out-of-sample gain

worth_having.note: sealed/S2 gains are real — but the pooled legs are binding

pooled_ll_no_regression_beyond_0_001.note: a TIE — the hinge's pooled gain is 0.0001, i.e. no sharpness recovered

sealed_70_80_band_lt_0_03.note: BINDING — the pooled-fitted slope a=3.3 over-sharpens sealed 0.66-0.75 rows (their sealed actuals are mild, unlike pooled), pushing them into the band at 0.187 band ECE

sealed_s2_arbiter.note: S2 ece 0.092 vs 0.1296 improves — but full-sealed and band legs fail

worth_having.note: no real improvement anywhere: pooled -0.0001 tie, sealed +0.0064 ll

phase2_gate_legs.determinism: probe double-run byte-identical (map params + metrics equal)

verdict_reason: Neither serving axis clears the full blocking leg set. R1 (raw identity) delivers REAL sealed/S2 gains (ll 0.6249->0.6218, S2 ece 0.1296->0.0808, sealed 70-80 band 0.1337->0.0366) but regresses pooled nested logloss +0.0030 beyond the +/-0.001 bar (platt is genuinely better in-sample: pooled above-0.70 raw is 9.3pp underconfident, and the logistic stretch corrects it), is worse on pooled ECE, and its sealed 80+ band regresses +0.0956 (n=16). R2 (hinge at h=0.66) is a pooled tie (-0.0001) and materially WORSE sealed (ll +0.0064, 70-80 band 0.1866) because the pooled-fitted slope a=3.3 cannot transfer to 2025's milder top tail. The serving-axis question is a genuine pooled-vs-sealed trade the repo's gated discipline (pooled +/-0.001 leg, sealed band/adjacent legs) resolves against changing. Production Platt twin UNCHANGED.
deeper_findings: e3aeece overfit hypothesis CONFIRMED: pchip's regression concentrates in-band where per-fold fits explode (std 0.118, outputs >1.0 at 0.85) — fold variance (Jensen), not smooth discrimination loss. A future flexible-map candidate must clip outputs to [0,1] and bound fold spread.

kink narrative REFINED: raw is dead-on only in the 0.66-0.70 sliver; below 0.66 raw is 2pp under, above 0.70 pooled raw is 9.3pp under — the global logistic's stretch is justified in-sample. The Platt over-stretch cost (Branch B, e3aeece) is an OUT-OF-SAMPLE (sealed-2025) phenomenon: 2025's top tail is mild where 2021-24's was steep.

consequence: no map fit on pooled 2021-24 can fix a sealed-2025 axis without over/under-sharpening risk — the correct next lever is either more sealed data (2026 in-season decided rows), or a product decision to weight the pooled +/-0.001 leg against sealed/S2 honesty (explicitly NOT made here).
follow_on_options_noted_not_taken: revisit when 2026 in-season decided rows exist (the sealed arbiter grows past n=285; the 70-80/80+ knife-edge legs get real power)
a product decision to relax the pooled +/-0.001 ll leg in favor of raw's sealed/S2 gains (records the sharpness-vs-out-of-sample-honesty trade the gate currently blocks)
future flexible-map candidates: clip to [0,1] and regularize fold spread (the pchip failure mode measured here)
